Great graphics, okay controls, good optimization. I didn't have any of the graphical problems that others had. The campaign is much too short though, and not varied enough. However, at the price I got this game, which was under 15 dollars, it's a steal.

I'm not a fan of having the Dreadnoughts as DLC though, it just reeks of moneygrubbing. The combat itself is already very shallow and imbalanced, both in the campaign and the multiplayer. The least they could do was add more game modes and better maps, but since THQ is going under, I don't know what's going to happen.

Be the Superhuman Soldier you always wanted to be!
Crush Greenskinskulls under your heavy Boots, Melt Orcfaces with the Melta Gun and Stomp these damn Xenos into the ground with your Jumppack and a Storm Hammer!

"Sucess is measured in blood; yours or your enemy's."
"It's Better to die for the Emporer than to live for yourself."
And "Only in Death does Duty end."

So ready your Bolters and Chainswords and show that Xenosscum who's planet this is!
For the Emporer!!
This game is a tiny glimpse at why the Warhammer 40,000 universe is one of the best out there.

Mixed feelings on this 1. Approx 10 hr Campaign on Hard. Imposing Gothic/ Industrial environments + visceral combat that mixes ranged and melee combat seamlessly . Checkpoint spacing, however isn't at its best. Thankfully the cutscenes are skippable. All in all, cinematic SP imo with a moving,epic score when present.
The multiplayer part of the game offers many unlockables/perks/challenges and this would've been a "go-to" title for 3rd person shooters on the PC, afa multi is concerned,  IF it worked. The P2P networking that is utilized leaves much to be disired for and while it isn't such an obstacle in the Exterminatus  4 pl co-op mode, it often spazes out in the 8vs8 pvp modes with multiple host migrations per match, shoddy  hit detection or poor match making. A title that pays great service to the IP by sticking to the script. Could've been a reference point had its creators given more attention to (technical) detail.
